ValidationRule.description: User can't edit Account C2 name after creation. Admin only
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(DW_Account_Type__c, "Global Customer"), ISPICKVAL(DW_Account_Type__c, "Business Name")) && ISCHANGED(Name),(NOW() - CreatedDate>0.000117), OR( AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "SuperUser", $Profile.Name <> "MDM", $Profile.Name <> "Operations Admin")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot edit the Account Name. Please contact your administrator.
